name: Month-end equity hedging flows at the London 4pm fix: does the predicted side pay after costs, out of sample?
question: Melvin & Prins (Journal of Financial Markets 22, 2015; sample 2004-2012) show that when a country's equity market outperforms over the month, its currency depreciates in the hour before the 4pm London fix on the last business day of the month, because international equity managers re-hedge at that fix (10% equity appreciation -> ~14 bp currency depreciation). In the 7 USD pairs: does a trade in the predicted direction, held from 15:00 to 16:00 London time on the last business day of each month, earn more than the measured cost in months the paper never saw?
motivation: The user asked for something that works after every direction signal failed (FOREX_ARASTIRMA.md). The fixing-reversal test (research/fix_reversal) found the paper's sign but a post-2019 size below the cost. Month-end hedging is a different, flow-based mechanism with a predicted size (several bp per month-end) well above the ~1 pip round trip in the majors.

equity_indices.source: Yahoo Finance daily closes in local currency, downloaded once and saved to research/month_end/equity_closes.csv before any outcome is computed

signal.relative_return: R = r_foreign - r_US, each the index's local-currency return from its last close on or before the previous month's last business day to its last close on or before the second-to-last business day of the current month (the paper's 'up until the second-to-last day').
signal.predicted_side: R > 0 -> foreign currency depreciates vs USD (sell foreign: SHORT XXXUSD / LONG USDXXX); R < 0 -> foreign currency appreciates. R = 0 or missing -> no trade. The sign only is traded; no size threshold.

trades: One trade per pair and month: last business day (Mon-Fri) of the month; enter at the open of the first 5M bar at or after 15:00 Europe/London, exit at the open of the first 5M bar at or after 16:00 Europe/London (both within 10 minutes, else skipped). If the last business day has no bars (holiday), the latest earlier business day with bars at both times is used.
cost: Round trip in pips = (measured median spread at entry NY hour + at exit NY hour) / 2 + 0.7 pip commission (data/ml/spread_profile.json). Spreads around the month-end fix can be wider than the median; the p90 version is reported.

hypothesis.H1: Mean net pips per trade, pooled over the 7 pairs, 2014-2026 > 0

statistics: Bootstrap resampling month-end dates as blocks (all pairs of a month-end together), 2000 resamples, seed 42; one hypothesis, two-sided 95% interval.
success_criterion: H1 passes if the 2014-2026 mean net is above zero with the 95% interval above zero, AND the mean net is above zero in both 2014-2019 and 2020-2026.

what_follows.pass: The app gets a month-end panel: on the last business day of the month it shows, per USD pair, the month's relative equity return, the predicted side for 15:00-16:00 London (17:00-18:00 / 18:00-19:00 Turkish time), and the measured 2014-2026 net pips and hit rate per pair. Pairs whose own net mean is not above zero are marked as not covering the cost.
what_follows.fail: No trading panel; the result is added to FOREX_ARASTIRMA.md.

information_only: Per pair and per sub-period gross, net, hit rate
2008-2012 (inside the paper's sample) as a replication of the sign
Own-index return instead of the relative return
The same hour on the other business days of the month (control: should show no relation)
parameter_search: None. Indices, window and rule are fixed above before outcomes are computed.
